hooks.command: if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/no-shell-file-reads.ps1"; elif command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec powershell.exe -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/no-shell-file-reads.ps1"; else exec bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/no-shell-file-reads.sh"; fi
